how: scripts/eval/seat_exam_llm_on.mjs bank (24 trade-bank items + 3 seat-exam items per seat, every wording from the bank) then ask --cap-usd 3: each wording put to the seat through think() end to end on production inside a capped rehearsal window. Graded by code (every expected fact present); the code misses then judged by the sales_engineer session (Claude on the subscription, no paid judge) against answer_must, only for what the wording asks.
caveat: The 16 trade entries authored 27 Oct are NOT in production yet (they load after merge). All 6 trade-bank fails concern those entries; the score after the load is the one to read. 3 items per seat is a small sample for 894.

items.wording: A client's CCTV quote lists a DVR, another lists an NVR. What is the actual difference?
A building owner asks why the addressable fire panel costs more than the conventional one. Explain.
What does 316 have that 304 does not, and why does it matter by the sea?
Why do some carpenters refuse MDF for the cabinet under the sink?
items.note: explains MDF swelling at edges, never says plywood holds screws and is the preferred wet-unit carcass (entry authored 27 Oct, not loaded yet)

items.wording: For a reception counter that gets knocked all day, melamine board or HPL?
items.note: picks HPL as more durable but never states low-pressure melamine vs high-pressure sheet with overlay (entry not loaded yet)

items.wording: What does E1 mean on an MDF certificate?
items.note: says it cannot establish the E1 limit; misses EN 13986 / 0.1 ppm (entry not loaded yet)

items.wording: A supplier calls his tile 'vitrified'. Does that make it porcelain?
Why does laminate swell in kitchens while SPC does not?
items.note: "printed fibreboard core" that swells at joints vs rigid stone-plastic SPC core: the HDF point in other words

items.wording: Why does epoxy crack in food plants?
items.note: lists many causes, hot washdown only in passing; no thermal-shock mismatch, no urethane cement (entry not loaded yet)

items.wording: How is the R slip class of a tile measured?
items.note: states DIN 51130 but says it cannot give the ramp procedure or angle bands (entry not loaded yet)

items.wording: A charcoal grill restaurant asks how often its hood and duct need checking.
items.note: charcoal grill = solid fuel = monthly, citing NFPA 96: exactly what the wording asks

items.wording: One quote says grinding and honing, another says crystallisation. Which job removes lippage?
Our carpet must be dry by the next morning. Which cleaning method?
items.note: recommends a very-low-moisture method over wet extraction for an overnight dry: the encapsulation point in other words

items.wording: Why do ready-mix plants use polycarboxylate admixtures in summer?
Can I paint over silicone?
items.note: cured silicone cannot be painted; use a paintable sealant: answers the wording; UV not asked

items.wording: What approval must a pest control company in Dubai hold?
items.note: DM Public Health Pest Control approval stated; misses that fumigation, termite and bird control need separate authorisation (entry not loaded yet)

items.wording: Why must termite soil treatment be done before the slab is poured?
Why does the temperature coefficient matter for solar panels in Dubai?
items.note: explains the temperature coefficient and why it matters in Dubai heat, as the wording asks

items.wording: The installer sent DEWA's old PDF of eligible equipment. Is that enough?
items.note: old PDF is not enough; current eligible list; DEWA-enrolled consultant/contractor: the DRRG point in substance

items.wording: What does a VRF system give that ducted splits do not?
Why does XLPE cable carry more current than PVC of the same copper size?
Why does tempered glass sometimes break by itself years later?
items.note: nickel sulphide inclusions and heat soak: answers the wording; "four times" not asked

items.wording: What is the difference between PE, FR and A2 core ACP?
items.note: PE combustible and not for facades; FR B-s1,d0; A2 ~90% mineral: every point

items.wording: Green MR board or cement board inside a shower?
The ceiling height on the interiors sheet does not match the duct routing on the mechanical layout. Which should the supplier quote against?
missing_by_code: written clarification rather than choosing one
items.note: neither drawing chosen; written clarification before pricing the affected lines

items.wording: The spec for the pumps says 'achieve 5 bar at the top floor' and names no brand. What kind of spec is that and what does it mean for quotes?
missing_by_code: leaving the product to the supplier
items.note: performance-based requirement; supplier proposes the pump against the duty

items.wording: The written spec calls for 20 mm porcelain but the floor plan legend says 10 mm. The client asks which we should price.
items.note: holds and asks in writing, but never says the contract order of precedence decides (same miss as 19 Oct)

items.wording: When someone messages our WhatsApp number for the very first time, what greets them?
The person skipped the options and wrote a long paragraph. How do we work out what he wants?
items.note: read for meaning, not keyword

items.wording: A supplier wants to know how big our supplier base is before joining. Do we give the figure?
items.note: never shares the internal supplier count

items.wording: If a buyer pays with a credit card, do they pay extra, and who eats the processing cost?
missing_by_code: nothing is added for paying by card
items.note: no surcharge and QuotesDone bears Stripe: correct, but the fee basis (about 2.9% plus AED 1) is missing

items.wording: A quote comes in at a hundred thousand dirhams. What do we keep?
A buyer lost their receipt. Where can they find it again?
items.note: invoice PDF in the customer portal

items.wording: If someone invests half a million at a two million valuation before the money, what stake does he get?
items.note: post-money 2.5M, 20%, existing holders diluted by 20%

items.wording: How do I show the subscription money in the monthly numbers?
items.note: MRR bridge only as an optional extra (new, churned, non-renewed), no four movements, no monthly cohorts

items.wording: Existing subscribers paid us more this year than last even after cancellations. What does that tell us?
missing_by_code: existing base grows on its own
items.note: NRR above 100%: the existing base grew on its own, with the GRR caveat

items.wording: One slow call in a quiet function: is that already a latency finding?
For a public-facing service, what are the core health signals a senior SRE looks at?
Why is the silence detector designed to wait at least one tick before it complains?
items.note: one-tick floor after the false SCHEDULER DOWN page of 17 September 2026

items.wording: A contracting magazine offers us a backlink for AED 500. Is that worth doing?
missing_by_code: never pay for a followed link
items.note: never pay for a followed link; rel="sponsored"

items.wording: Our how-it-works clip never appears in Google results. What are we missing?
A reel reached 20,000 people but brought zero sign-ups. Which numbers tell us what went wrong?
